questions.question: Is the ordinary path clear?
questions.evidence: Seven visible setup steps, bordered full-row disk selection, clear review and real installed restart.

questions.question: Is it convenient?
questions.evidence: Exact extracted VMware package installs with enabled devices; no terminal command or separate driver installer.

questions.question: Is it user friendly?
questions.evidence: Separate destructive consent, navigable errors and retained document/folder data; a reachable caption restores off-screen windows.

questions.question: Is the graphics result coherent?
questions.evidence: Native clipped movement compares the whole viewport with a separate full repaint at 100/150/200 percent; real 4K capture.

questions.question: Is essential text readable?
questions.evidence: Reviewed normal installer/desktop and native HiDPI text use consistent antialiased typography; off-screen clipping is intentional and reversible.

limits: Agent scenario and native screenshot review; no child/older-adult human study
Correctness proof is distinct from smooth physical monitor frame rates or universal GPU support
